title: Scaled dot-product attention
hook: Attention lets each query decide how much to read from every value, based on how well it matches each key. It is the core operation of the Transformer.

symbols.meaning: queries, one row per position asking for information
keys, one row per position being matched
values, the content that gets mixed

equation.caption: Softmax is applied to each row.

explorations.title: Equal scores spread attention evenly
explorations.predict: If all keys are identical, how is attention split?
explorations.observe: Every weight becomes 1/3 and the output is the plain average of V.
explorations.why: Equal scores give equal exponentials, so softmax returns a uniform distribution.

explorations.title: A dominant score takes over
explorations.predict: What happens when one key matches the query much better?
explorations.observe: q1 puts nearly all weight on k1, so its output copies V row 1.
explorations.why: Softmax exaggerates gaps between scores exponentially.

self_tests.name: output equals weighted sum of V

limitation: Real Transformers learn Q, K, V from data and use many heads; here they are hand-set toy matrices.
misconception: Attention weights are not probabilities that a word is 'important' overall; they are per-query mixing coefficients.

claims.text: Scores are divided by sqrt(d_k) to keep softmax out of regions with tiny gradients for large d_k.
The specific matrices shown are invented examples.

outcomes.outcome: Compute scores, softmax weights and output
Compare equal scores with a dominant score
